user_instruction: 看下 openharmony 以及对应 sig 等仓库是否有，如果有就补齐，如果没有就认为是能力不支持
scope: Nine exact original complete-provider findings only. Available frameworks, local limited code/data and access-limited repository observations remain explicit. No broad SysCap/API/backend exclusion.

LiveCaptions.reason: No complete distributable real-time caption provider in verified OpenHarmony/SIG sources; sample model objects/dependencies/licensing and streaming provider are incomplete.

NumberIdentity.reason: Public local user mark/limited lookup implementation exists; complete dataset and SpamShield/HSDR providers for the original aggregate are not supplied. The local subset remains a separate integration task.

DeviceAttest.reason: Framework exists; valid product identity, cloud registration token and provisioning are not public default inputs.

SecurityGuardModels.reason: Official 7.0 and master production modelcfg are empty; no complete default risk model in inspected sources.

AudioVividMetaBuilder.reason: Official implementation supplies wrapper/abstract ABI/optional dlopen; complete MetaBuilder plugin absent from inspected build targets and Media SIG component list.

ScreenReader.reason: Accessibility framework exists; no verified matching screen reader/TTS complete provider in inspected sources or official prebuilt index.

DesktopLyrics.reason: AVSession connector exists; no verified matching DesktopLyricAbility provider. Music_Demo installs a different bundle and is not this backend.

ExpandedTextMenu.reason: ACE exposes plugin loader/ABI; no matching complete action/backend implementation or artifact in inspected official sources.

TextServicePlugins.reason: Share/translation/analyzer loaders/interfaces/default fallbacks exist; no verified matching complete content/model/service plugins for QEMU.

reopen: Supply a complete lawful provider/data/model/product identity, integrate it and restore that exact finding to runtime acceptance.
